title: An interest-payment waiver on a CHARGED-OFF loan merges principal and interest into ONE INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST credit (loan 11 L42: credit 260.00, debit 260.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_PAYMENT_WAIVER posted on loan 11 (product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT) when the loan was MARKED CHARGED OFF on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 42 (externalId L42): principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", interestPortion 10.0 -> "1000", fee 0, penalty 0, overpayment 0. charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff true (a non-reversed chargeOff transaction L41 precedes L42). accounts is the product mapping from create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (sha256 af7c2cde...f13d): loanPortfolio 2, receivables 4, overpayment 17, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the two L42 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 103 CREDIT account 20 260.0 (the principal and interest portions MERGED onto ONE charge-off income credit), JE 104 DEBIT account 9 260.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the charged-off branch switching all four portfolio/receivable credits to INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST and merging them. It discriminates loan-wrong-ipw-ignores-charge-off (which would post CREDIT 2 25000, CREDIT 4 1000, DEBIT 9 26000). Nothing was computed; exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
